title: Intel Loihi 2 脈衝計算平臺
summary: 以非同步事件、可程式神經元及本地突觸解析Intel Loihi 2 脈衝計算平臺：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Intel Loihi 2 spiking-compute platform through asynchronous events, programmable neurons and local synapses: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 原創張量、運算成本及失效分析。架構圖是功能教學示意，非晶片floorplan或專有電路；數字為假想，需依精度、shape、資料分佈與系統邊界重算。
scopeEn: Original tensor, compute-cost and failure analysis. Functional diagrams are not chip floorplans/proprietary circuits; assumed values need recalculation for precision, shape, data and boundaries.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在Intel Loihi 2 脈衝計算平臺案例中比較graded spike事件與膜狀態微碼，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate graded-spike events and membrane-state microcode within the Intel Loihi 2 spiking-compute platform case.

steps.title: 脈衝與時間編碼：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Spikes and temporal encoding: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對graded spike事件提出可反駁的脈衝與時間編碼模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable spikes and temporal encoding model and evidence record for graded-spike events.
steps.instruction: 在「Intel Loihi 2 脈衝計算平臺」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識graded spike事件。神經形態計算以事件與狀態演化表達信息；脈衝頻率只是可能編碼之一。 建立脈衝與時間編碼的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是非同步事件、可程式神經元及本地突觸。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較頻率及事件時間對同一輸入的表示。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify graded-spike events in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Intel Loihi 2 spiking-compute platform. Neuromorphic computation uses events/state evolution; firing rate is one possible encoding. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of spikes and temporal encoding, focusing on asynchronous events, programmable neurons and local synapses. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare rate and event-time representations for one input. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較頻率及事件時間對同一輸入的表示。
steps.observationEn: Compare rate and event-time representations for one input.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：脈衝網絡只能使用固定頻率編碼。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Spiking networks can use only fixed rate codes.
steps.check: 提交graded spike事件的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for graded-spike events.

knowledge.title: 脈衝與時間編碼

knowledge.textEn: Neuromorphic computation uses events/state evolution; firing rate is one possible encoding. Course architecture correspondence: Graded-spike events

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 比較頻率及事件時間對同一輸入的表示。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；脈衝網絡只能使用固定頻率編碼。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Compare rate and event-time representations for one input. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Spiking networks can use only fixed rate codes.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設1000個神經元各平均10次/s，每事件成本20 nJ，核心事件能量率為1000×10×20 nJ/s=0.2 mW。未含閒置、輸入編碼、讀出與供電；不能當成Loihi實測或端到端功率。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 1000 neurons at 10 events/s with 20 nJ/event: event power is 0.2 mW. Idle, encoding, readout and supply are excluded; this is neither Loihi measurement nor end-to-end power.

quiz.question: 就graded spike事件的「脈衝與時間編碼」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for spikes and temporal encoding in graded-spike events?
options: 神經形態計算以事件與狀態演化表達信息；脈衝頻率只是可能編碼之一。
脈衝網絡只能使用固定頻率編碼。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Neuromorphic computation uses events/state evolution; firing rate is one possible encoding.
Spiking networks can use only fixed rate codes.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 神經形態計算以事件與狀態演化表達信息；脈衝頻率只是可能編碼之一。 比較頻率及事件時間對同一輸入的表示。
quiz.explanationEn: Neuromorphic computation uses events/state evolution; firing rate is one possible encoding. Compare rate and event-time representations for one input.

steps.title: 脈衝與時間編碼：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Spikes and temporal encoding: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對graded spike事件提出可反駁的脈衝與時間編碼模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable spikes and temporal encoding model and evidence record for graded-spike events.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「脈衝與時間編碼」模型，檢查graded spike事件的兩個假想案例。比較頻率及事件時間對同一輸入的表示。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分神經形態計算以事件與狀態演化表達信息；脈衝頻率只是可能編碼之一。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous spikes and temporal encoding model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving graded-spike events. Compare rate and event-time representations for one input. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Neuromorphic computation uses events/state evolution; firing rate is one possible encoding." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 比較頻率及事件時間對同一輸入的表示。
steps.observationEn: Compare rate and event-time representations for one input.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：脈衝網絡只能使用固定頻率編碼。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Spiking networks can use only fixed rate codes.
steps.check: 提交graded spike事件的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for graded-spike events.

steps.title: 膜電位與閾值：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Membrane state and threshold: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對膜狀態微碼提出可反駁的膜電位與閾值模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable membrane state and threshold model and evidence record for membrane-state microcode.
steps.instruction: 在「Intel Loihi 2 脈衝計算平臺」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識膜狀態微碼。神經元模型積累、泄漏及發放；離散時間近似需要說明步長。 建立膜電位與閾值的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是非同步事件、可程式神經元及本地突觸。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。重算小型leaky積分模型與兩種步長誤差。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify membrane-state microcode in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Intel Loihi 2 spiking-compute platform. Neuron models accumulate, leak and fire; discrete approximations need timestep labels. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of membrane state and threshold, focusing on asynchronous events, programmable neurons and local synapses. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Recompute a leaky integrator with two timestep errors. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 重算小型leaky積分模型與兩種步長誤差。
steps.observationEn: Recompute a leaky integrator with two timestep errors.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：改變時間步不會影響發放時間。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Changing timestep never affects firing time.
steps.check: 提交膜狀態微碼的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for membrane-state microcode.
